provenance_note: This is a replication that changes validation cadence after the original test results were already viewed. The test records are the same fold 10 records; they are not a newly unseen confirmatory test set. Validation chooses each best checkpoint by raw overall macro-AUROC. The 100-step and 250-step checkpoint grids are not nested. Original artifacts are read-only.
